assertions: Complete original low-level PropertyBag and OPropertyContainerHelper retain separate default/holder/descriptor ownership, declared real/Any/held locations, lossless UNO normalization, untouched unchanged outputs, original diagnostics, default empty-name rejection, forced MAYBEVOID, removal/default semantics and name-sorted left-first descriptor merge. PropertyDescription retains signed handles, original nested location enum and logical64 size_t maximum. Type now exposes its actual private pointer through one stable compiler lvalue; generated Property no longer writes that private field reflectively. Property.unacquired projects only existing declared fields, with no new UNO value/refcount/type provider; sorting temporaries use actual generated Property values. Newly consumed generated exceptions retain real Type/Any/copy/move/Context behavior through the injected host ABI. Source removed-holder retention is preserved as CALC-547/WRITER481. The separate OPropertyBag UNO service, PropertyArray/notification helpers, SfxDocumentMetaData and complete DOCX/XLSX shell/UI remain unfinished; STL allocation/move traces, physical ABI, native threading and final/access/const enforcement remain unqualified.
